name: zlog-60430e5e-blind15
instr:
# Diagnosing a C logging library without a test suite

The repository has received 15 separate undocumented edits.

A program that uses this library to write its own diagnostic lines out to files now goes wrong from the moment it starts, and goes on going wrong in what it writes. Nothing about the settings files changed and nothing about the calling programs changed.

Getting it going is where the trouble begins. The call that reads the settings reports failure for every settings file handed to it and for settings handed over as plain text, even the shortest ones, so no message can ever be written. Where that call does return, no output appears at all and the files named in the settings are made and left empty. Asking for a lower and an upper bound on the space set aside for one message brings the same emptiness, the two bounds being taken in the wrong order. Shutting it down and bringing it back up inside one process leaves it dead the second time round, the calls returning while nothing reaches the files.

Writing down what is wanted and having it taken is no better. Naming a severity by its text on an output line is refused as something that cannot be turned into a severity value, and the load stops there, while a name of no length at all is swallowed instead. Giving a layout a name of its own is refused too, with a complaint that the name holds a character that is not permitted.
